name: MEB Corporation Public Company Limited
summary: MEB Corporation Public Company Limited oversees an online platform specializing in the distribution of digital books and audio content. Their extensive library of e-books features various genres, including fiction, graphic novels, periodicals, general interest titles, and a unique "buffet" subscription model. In addition to content, MEB also supplies e-reading devices and supplementary services. The company's operations are based in Nonthaburi, Thailand.
